svg.title: The images of Nextcloud
svg.desc: When Nextcloud publishes a release, the weekly run tests its floating tag, and opens the issue A supported Nextcloud release breaks the app when the tests fail, while every pull request goes on with the pins of nextcloud-images.txt. A week after the release, Renovate moves the pins in one pull request. When its required check nextcloud passes, it merges, and every pull request tests the new release; when it fails, it stays open and the pins stay. When Nextcloud publishes a new major version, the upstream bot raises max-version, the check of the pins fails, and the fix bot runs pin-images.sh on that pull request, which adds the pin of the new version.
